templates.why_chosen: Deployment-style figure with photographic server and device icons instead of abstract boxes: only the inserted Tooth module is outlined red inside a plain codec pipeline, and three colored lines fan out to three player devices.
templates.what_to_learn: When the paper's contribution is one small module inserted into an existing pipeline, outline just that box in red and leave its neighbors plain rather than recoloring the whole chain; realistic device photos can stand in for the host and client, but keep enough labels that arrow direction is not left to guesswork.
